回滚会产生一条新的变更集，不会删除原始记录。不可逆项、冲突项和失败项会保留原因。: A rollback creates a new changeset and preserves the original history. Reasons are retained for irreversible, conflicting and failed items.
回滚已完成，回滚本身已记录为新的变更集: Rollback completed and recorded in a new changeset.
数据已变化，请检查最新的回滚预览: Data has changed. Review the updated rollback preview.
查看此次回滚产生的变更集: View the changeset created by this rollback
每次修改都有记录。回滚仅还原本次涉及的字段；被后续操作改动的记录会明确提示冲突。: Every change is recorded. Rollback restores only the fields involved and reports conflicts with later changes.
部分项目回滚失败，请查看详情中的失败原因: Some items could not be rolled back. View their failure reasons in the details.
共享补偿数据的条目会自动整组选中。: Items sharing compensation data are selected as a group.
所选条目已回滚，其余条目仍可继续回滚: Selected items were rolled back. The remaining items can be rolled back later.
仅回滚本次预览中可执行的所选条目；冲突项保留原因并可重试。每次回滚都会生成独立的: Only selected items marked ready in this preview will be rolled back. Conflicts retain their reasons and can be retried. Each rollback creates a separate changeset that can itself be undone.
请至少选择一个变更条目: Select at least one changeset item.
条目 {id} 不属于当前变更集: Item {id} does not belong to this changeset.
条目 {id} 重复选择: Item {id} was selected more than once.
条目 {id} 未执行写入，无需回滚: Item {id} did not perform a write and does not need rollback.
条目使用原子补偿，必须整组选中: These items use atomic compensation and must be selected together.
此条目已回滚，不会重复执行: This item was already rolled back and will not run again.
当前字段与变更记录不一致: Current fields no longer match the recorded change.
同组条目无法回滚：{reason}: Another item in this group cannot be rolled back: {reason}
冲突条目及其原子补偿组不会执行；其余所选条目会独立回滚。: Conflicting items and their atomic groups will be skipped. Other selected items will be rolled back independently.
回滚变更集 {id} 中选定的 {count} 项: Roll back {count} selected items in changeset {id}
请先预览选定条目的回滚结果: Preview the selected rollback items first.
所选条目或数据已变化，请重新预览: The selection or data has changed. Preview again.
回滚变更集不能与原变更集相同: The rollback changeset must differ from the original changeset.
原变更条目状态已变化，不能恢复回滚状态: The original item status has changed; its rollback state cannot be restored.
原子补偿组的历史状态不一致，请核对后处理: The recorded state of this atomic compensation group is inconsistent. Review its history before proceeding.
